change.summary: Propagate the existing bounded failover selection signal into changed-route persistence so a stalled private save cannot retain the acquired SecretLease or keep the in-process routing mutation pending after the request deadline.

before_implementation.observed_failure: The client received the bounded total-deadline response, but the SecretLease acquired by the still-pending selector remained undisposed.
before_implementation.bounded_cleanup: The controlled fixture save gate was released during cleanup and the command exited normally in 109 milliseconds.

failure_injections: a changed-route private save is held beyond a 25 millisecond failover deadline
the acquired SecretLease is disposed after the deadline
readiness fails closed and the running current route remains unchanged after the late save completes

covers: HTTP/SSE bounded pre-semantic failover and post-semantic no-replay
WebSocket bounded pre-semantic failover and post-semantic no-replay
durable and abortable automatic routing plus durable manual routing

deployment.reason: The previously proven sudo root-GID transition failure and non-writable /opt/codex-account-router boundary are unchanged.

remaining_limits: 0.2.14 is verified but is not active until a host-privileged operator runs the rollback-capable router-only deployment script.

Node filesystem promises cannot cancel an already-issued atomic save. The running router remains fail closed and ignores its late result, but a late successful file replacement may be observed after an operator restart.

Aborting a changed-route save makes routing persistence unavailable for the running process; an operator must inspect the private state boundary and restart rather than receiving an optimistic automatic recovery.
The tests use synthetic accounts only and do not qualify a real A-to-B switch.
Real two-account verification remains blocked until explicit enrollment authorization.
